_meta.purpose: The third themeKey population. `set` REQUIRES a themeKey (adapters/items/kinds.py, KindCatalog.cs), and the 36 build set families are keyed on (aptitude, archetype) and belong to no species - so without this file a build set is unauthorable. RULED 2026-09-04: a third `build.` namespace, not a loosened `themeKey` (spec-demon-themes.md 7 names making themeKey REQUIRED on `unique` as the intended direction, and loosening it here would reverse that).
_meta.collisionNote: Collision-free against `theme.*` (legacy, 13 registered / 5 in use) and `demon.*` by construction - the same namespace split spec-demon-themes.md 2.2a already established. Three prefixes, one union, no shared body.
_meta.derivation: MECHANICAL, not authored: 12 aptitudes x 3 archetypes. The aptitude axis is read from data/seed/aptitudes/roster.json (the checked-in mirror of AptitudeCatalog.All, which computes its own count as PostureCount x PerPosture) so a thirteenth aptitude changes this grid by construction rather than by a forgotten edit. `aptitudeMeaning` and `aptitudeReading` are that roster's own `role`/`reading` strings, carried verbatim into the brief - no flavour is invented here. `antiMotifs` is the opposing archetype, which is a derivation, not a judgement.
_meta.appendOnly: Append-only, like every other theme population. An entry is retired with `retired: true`, never deleted, and an id is never reused.
_meta.notFrozen: Deliberately NOT frozen. themes.v1.json and naming.v1.json are frozen wave-0 registries whose bumps cost an explicit re-run decision; this file is derived from a roster that is itself allowed to grow, so freezing it would make an aptitude addition a registry ceremony.
